name: plugin-engineering
description: Builds and maintains a public Claude Code plugin marketplace on GitHub from the official docs, distilled for plugins that third parties install: marketplaces, manifests, skills, agents, hooks, mods, MCP servers, settings, validation and releases, checked against the latest release notes. Includes the complete plugin CLI reference: every claude plugin and claude plugin marketplace subcommand, /plugin form and session flag, with exact flags, messages, JSON fields, exit codes and minimum versions. Tests, troubleshoots and debugs plugins: why one won't install, load or run, a check before publishing, and plugin evals with CI gates. Plans and carries out renames, merges, splits, updates, retirements and removals of plugins and marketplaces in every context a plugin lives in, and asks before any step that deletes a plugin, its data or a marketplace.
